interactions.note: The epitope of Fab35 on the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR) α1 extracellular domain was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex of Fab35/nAChRα1 ECD/α-Btx, solved by molecular replacement. A mutant of nAChR α1 ECD that contains three stabilization mutations, referred to as α211, was employed and α-bungarotoxin (α-Btx) was included to stabilize flexible regions of nAChR α1 ECD that may hinder crystallization.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.61 angstroms

The epitope of Fab35 on the mouse nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR) α1 extracellular domain was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex of Fab35/nAChRα1 ECD/α-Btx, solved by molecular replacement. A mutant of nAChR α1 ECD that contains three stabilization mutations, referred to as α211, was employed and α-bungarotoxin (α-Btx) was included to stabilize flexible regions of nAChR α1 ECD that may hinder crystallization.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.7 angstroms
